articles.title: Taliban voices concern over US plans to deport Afghans
articles.summary: Afghanistan's Taliban authorities voiced concern over reported plans by Washington to deport scores of Afghan immigrants to Pakistan with the aim of their eventual return to their home country.

articles.title: UN's peacekeeping mission in disputed Western Sahara ends after 35 years
articles.summary: The U.N.'s long-running peacekeeping mission for the disputed Western Sahara ceased operations Sunday after 35 years. Once ruled by Spain, it is claimed by both Morocco and the pro-independence Polisario Front.

articles.title: Hebron governor says Israeli forces withdraw from city after 10-day siege
articles.summary: Governor Khaled Dudin says families who were forced from their homes can return.
